mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months compresses equity valuations via higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market characterized by strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100,000 jobs/month) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals an overheating economy that prompts aggressive Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS > 100 and UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle economic expansions, strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1400 thousand units) signals robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1400 and the economy is in an early-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 22700 billion dollars, it signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 < 22700.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 700,000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 700.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 312.0, it signals elevated inflation that erodes real corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 312.0.
